subject.title: fix: provider usage accounting, retry/overflow classification, and output clamping

question: Should direct Anthropic provider calls now default to zero SDK retries, and should cacheWrite1h plus allowEmptySignature become permanent public plugin-SDK contracts?
rationale: These are shipped provider and plugin API semantics rather than purely internal fixes; tests can verify implementation but cannot choose the intended compatibility boundary.

options.title: Prove caller-owned retries
options.body: Keep the new defaults only after auditing shipped entry points, covering direct and outer-managed callers, and explicitly accepting both additive SDK fields.

options.title: Preserve direct-call retries
options.body: Pass zero retries only from outer-managed application paths while leaving direct provider calls on the SDK default, and keep the public fields only where externally required.

options.title: Accept the compatibility change
options.body: Intentionally adopt zero retries and both SDK additions with maintainer approval, upgrade notes, and real near-context behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Prove caller-owned retries
recommendation.body: Keep the new defaults only after auditing shipped entry points, covering direct and outer-managed callers, and explicitly accepting both additive SDK fields.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available prior model/provider history and owns the current proposed boundary change.
